summary_policy: Offline summaries are original Daedalus prose. External source text is not copied.

sources.title: The Python Tutorial
sources.offline_summary: A guided introduction to Python syntax, data structures, functions, modules, classes, and errors.

sources.title: Virtual Environments and Packages
sources.offline_summary: Explains why isolated Python environments prevent dependency conflicts and how to create and use one.

sources.title: unittest - Unit testing framework
sources.offline_summary: Defines test cases, fixtures, suites, runners, assertions, and automated discovery in Python's standard library.

sources.title: pathlib - Object-oriented filesystem paths
sources.offline_summary: Documents platform-aware path objects and safe, readable operations for navigating files and directories.

sources.title: subprocess - Subprocess management
sources.offline_summary: Describes child-process execution, timeouts, captured output, and shell-injection risks.

sources.title: pickle - Python object serialization
sources.offline_summary: Documents Python object serialization and the critical rule that untrusted pickle data can execute code.

sources.title: Packaging Python Projects
sources.offline_summary: Shows the standard source layout, project metadata, build artifacts, licenses, and installation verification for Python packages.

sources.title: MIT 18.06SC Linear Algebra
sources.offline_summary: Covers matrix operations, vector spaces, least squares, eigenvalues, positive definite matrices, and singular value decomposition.

sources.title: MIT 18.01SC Single Variable Calculus
sources.offline_summary: Develops derivatives as rates of change, differentiation rules, optimization, integration, and series.

sources.title: MIT 18.05 Introduction to Probability and Statistics
sources.offline_summary: Introduces random variables, distributions, conditional probability, inference, uncertainty, and linear regression.

sources.title: NumPy: the absolute basics for beginners
sources.offline_summary: Introduces arrays, dimensions, shapes, indexing, aggregation, and vectorized numerical work.

sources.title: NumPy fundamentals
sources.offline_summary: Collects the core rules for creation, indexing, dtypes, broadcasting, copies, views, and universal functions.

sources.title: Broadcasting
sources.offline_summary: Defines trailing-axis compatibility and explains how differently shaped arrays participate in elementwise operations.

sources.title: Data types
sources.offline_summary: Explains NumPy scalar types, precision, conversion, and why a chosen dtype changes range, accuracy, and memory.

sources.title: Linear algebra
sources.offline_summary: Reference for matrix products, norms, decompositions, eigenproblems, least squares, and systems of equations.

sources.title: Random Generator
sources.offline_summary: Documents Generator, explicit seeds, distributions, and reproducible random-number streams within a recorded environment.

sources.title: numpy.savez
sources.offline_summary: Defines the non-executable NPZ container used to save multiple named arrays.

sources.title: Pro Git
sources.offline_summary: Explains Git's snapshot model, staging area, commits, branches, remotes, merging, recovery, and collaboration.

sources.title: gitignore documentation
sources.offline_summary: Defines ignore-pattern precedence and the key limitation that ignore rules do not affect files already tracked.

sources.title: githooks documentation
sources.offline_summary: Describes client and server hooks, their inputs, execution points, and how a nonzero result can stop an operation.

sources.title: Understanding GitHub Actions
sources.offline_summary: Introduces event-driven workflows, jobs, runners, steps, artifacts, and automated build and test pipelines.

sources.title: Supply chain security
sources.offline_summary: Maps manifests and lockfiles to GitHub's dependency graph, review, alerts, updates, SBOM, and provenance features.

sources.title: About the dependabot.yml file
sources.offline_summary: Explains how repository configuration selects package ecosystems, manifest locations, update schedules, and pull-request behavior.

sources.title: REST API endpoints for Dependabot alerts
sources.offline_summary: Defines authenticated repository and organization endpoints for reading and managing Dependabot alerts.

sources.title: Push protection from the command line
sources.offline_summary: Explains how supported secrets can block a push and why exposed credentials must be rotated rather than merely hidden.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework 1.1
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.offline_summary: Organizes secure-development practices around preparing the organization, protecting software, producing well-secured releases, and responding to vulnerabilities.

sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.offline_summary: Provides voluntary functions and vocabulary for governing, mapping, measuring, and managing risks in AI systems.

sources.title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
sources.offline_summary: The landmark 1986 report showing how multilayer networks can learn internal representations by propagating output error backward.

sources.title: Automatic Differentiation in Machine Learning: a Survey
sources.offline_summary: Distinguishes automatic, symbolic, and numerical differentiation and explains forward and reverse accumulation.

sources.title: Understanding the difficulty of training deep feedforward neural networks
sources.offline_summary: Analyzes activation and gradient behavior in deep networks and proposes variance-aware parameter initialization.

sources.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
sources.offline_summary: Introduces an optimizer that combines moving estimates of first and second gradient moments with bias correction.

sources.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
sources.offline_summary: Develops stochastic unit removal during training as a practical regularizer and model-averaging approximation.

sources.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
sources.offline_summary: Introduces normalization of mini-batch activations as a trainable architectural operation.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.offline_summary: Presents an encoder-decoder architecture built from attention, feed-forward blocks, residual paths, normalization, and positional information.

sources.title: PyTorch Reproducibility
sources.offline_summary: Explains random-state control, deterministic operations, performance tradeoffs, and why results are not guaranteed across releases or platforms.

sources.title: Hugging Face Transformers Trainer
sources.offline_summary: Documents a configurable training and evaluation loop with batching, callbacks, mixed precision, and distributed strategies for Transformer models.

sources.title: DVC Data and Model Versioning
sources.offline_summary: Shows how small metadata files connect Git revisions to large data and model artifacts stored outside the code repository.

sources.title: Hydra Configuration Framework
sources.offline_summary: Introduces composable hierarchical configuration, command-line overrides, local or remote launchers, and repeatable parameter sweeps.

sources.title: MLflow Experiment Tracking
sources.offline_summary: Describes runs that record parameters, metrics, datasets, models, artifacts, and source context in local or shared tracking stores.

sources.title: Hugging Face Model Cards
sources.offline_summary: Defines model documentation covering intended use, limits, training parameters, datasets, evaluation results, bias, and ethical considerations.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Signals
sources.offline_summary: Explains vendor-neutral traces, metrics, logs, and contextual signals used to understand production behavior.

sources.title: Get started with Streamlit
sources.offline_summary: Introduces Streamlit's rerun-based application model, widgets, layout, state, caching, and multipage data apps.

sources.title: FastAPI Tutorial - User Guide
sources.offline_summary: Builds typed HTTP endpoints, validation, error handling, testing, and generated OpenAPI documentation step by step.
